points.why: Makes the agent look answers up in a maintained, owned dependency record, built from logs, code, CMDB and config, and cite each source; that is the knowledge-graph idea in substance, if not by name.
Says sessions agree because they read the same data, answers carry citations staff can follow, and corrections flow back into a shared record.
Says citations make answers checkable and the system is only as good as its data, but never says that cheap checking keeps human scrutiny from eroding.
